The construction of the runway will also result in the closure of part of Grogan Road on the Perth Airport estate that [...] ### Runways

[edit]

Flights are serviced by two runways – the main 03/21 runway, 3,444 m × 45 m (11,299 ft × 148 ft) and 06/24, 2,163 m × 45 m (7,096 ft × 148 ft).

In 1965, Runway 03/21 was extended from 7,500 ft (2,286 m) to 10,000 ft (3,048 m) to accommodate Boeing 707s. [...] Perth Airport (IATA: PER, ICAO: YPPH) is an international, domestic and general aviation airport serving Perth, Western Australia. It is one of five airports within the Perth metropolitan area, the fourth busiest airport in Australia measured by passenger movements, and falls within the boundaries of the cities of Belmont, Kalamunda and Swan in the east of the Perth metropolitan area. It is the sole airport with regular international flights in Western Australia.
